report.summary: The AP-removal change works (AP-only onboarding, station on commissioning), but the commissioned-reboot crash is unchanged — the identical CPU 'Cache error' at PC 0xAFD6A25E inside ieee80211_getmgtframe from ieee80211_send_probereq, same cycle count — so two rounds of product-side Wi-Fi sequencing changes have not moved it.

deviceInfo.appVersion: zerocode_ai_firmware 1.0.0, ESP-IDF e9da155a, ELF SHA256 afb21c100
deviceInfo.bootTime: fresh boot reaches the console ~2.1 s after reset; the configured boot aborts ~1.7 s after reset
deviceInfo.chip: ESP32-S31 rev v0.0, 2 cores, 16 MB flash, 16 MB PSRAM
deviceInfo.connectivity: AP-only onboarding when unconfigured (wifi:mode : softAP); commissioning switches the radio to station (wifi:mode : sta); no broker peer in the emulator, so every dial fails 'Host is unreachable'
deviceInfo.crash: still the same CPU 'Cache error' (mcause 0x19, PC=0xAFD6A25E, ra=0x400482E4 in ieee80211_getmgtframe, #28 ieee80211_send_probereq) at the same cycle count (~166820000) on the configured boot
deviceInfo.freeHeap: not re-read on the crashed boot; ~12.5 MB free overall on the fresh boot

notes: The fix retired the APSTA path (fresh boot now logs 'wifi:mode : softAP' alone, commissioning logs 'wifi:mode : sta'), yet the configured-reboot crash is byte-for-byte the same fault: same unaligned PC 0xAFD6A25E, same cycle count, same ieee80211_getmgtframe → ieee80211_send_probereq backtrace. Moving esp_wifi_connect() onto mqtt_net changed nothing, so that hypothesis is refuted by this run.

Both crashes in this session come from the Wi-Fi driver's own management-frame path while the station scans/associates. Pointing the station at an SSID that does not exist makes the emulated driver build a probe-request management frame and fault at an unmapped code address — a driver/emulator fault, not a product handler (nothing of ours is on the frame path; our handlers only post to the net-task queue).

To separate 'this emulator's Wi-Fi driver faults on the station scan' from 'the product triggers it', the next run should be judged together with a hardware session: on the real Korvo-1 the same commissioning + reboot must be exercised with a real access point. Blind stack/ordering changes in app_mqtt will not move this fault — two rounds of such changes left it identical.
The fresh boot and the AP-only onboarding are healthy, and flashing always lands on that path because flashing wipes NVS.

Non-fatal lines, not counted on their own: sdmmc_init_ocr 0x107 (no SD card), sccb_i2c transmit error then a correct ov3660 detection, 'i2s_common: GPIO 4/5 is not usable', 'gpio: conflict found for GPIO[7]', phy RF-calibration fallback, 'wifi:sta is connecting, return error' during commissioning (connect already in progress), the emulator's failed-handshake warning for its virtual Wi-Fi client, and the usual Wi-Fi rate/power dump.
report.suggestedFix: Stop iterating on product ordering: the configured-boot crash is identical (same PC 0xAFD6A25E, same cycle count, inside ieee80211_getmgtframe from ieee80211_send_probereq) after APSTA removal and after moving esp_wifi_connect() to mqtt_net, so no product-side change tested so far affects it. Treat it as an emulated Wi-Fi driver fault on the station scan against an absent SSID until a real board disproves it: on hardware, commission the panel against a real AP and reboot it twice. If it reproduces on silicon, the lever is the Wi-Fi init/scan configuration (e.g. esp_wifi_set_bandwidth/scan params, WIFI_INIT_CONFIG_DEFAULT static buffers, CONFIG_ESP_WIFI_* options) rather than app_mqtt's sequencing. In parallel, keep the genuinely open product work: the spec's 'set the office to 21' voice phrase, and the single-button factory reset vs SET+MODE.

tests.details: The boot after the console 'reboot' of the commissioned panel still aborts with a CPU 'Cache error' (mcause 0x19) at PC 0xAFD6A25E — the same unaligned, unmapped address and cycle count as the previous round — inside ieee80211_getmgtframe from ieee80211_send_probereq, ~1.7 s after reset, right after the button bindings. The emulator exits (code 1) and the panel stays off. Moving the station start onto mqtt_net and removing APSTA did not change the fault.
tests.evidence: [WARN machine::rom_stubs] panic_info: reason='Cache error' … mepc=0xAFD6A25E ra=0x400482E4 mcause=0x19 / [WARN machine] Firmware abort on hart0: 'Cache error' / CPU fault at PC=0xAFD6A25E after 166821026 cycles / #10 0x400482e4 in ieee80211_getmgtframe () / #28 0x40042dea in ieee80211_send_probereq () / [host] emulator stopped: esp-emu exited on its own (exit code 1)
tests.name: Boot after a reboot of a commissioned panel — no crash / reset (previously failing)
